change: Delegated window partition directories allocate only occupied buckets, preserving ascending bucket order and shallow row-copy semantics. Shared validation rejects unsafe and invalid counts even for empty input. Fan-in now admits merge directories, row slots, sort workspace, evaluation directories and output ordinal records; it detaches borrowed partial payloads once under admission and retains those charges with explicit result ownership, avoiding redundant shallow row copies and argument-spread limits. Merge scratch lives in a child scope and is released before ownership returns to the caller.

edgeCases: MAX_SAFE_INTEGER logical buckets with twelve rows and two occupied buckets
zero, negative, fractional, NaN, infinite and unsafe counts with empty inputs
existing cross-task window results and Parquet task fixtures
Merge measured peak succeeds, peak minus one rejects and cleans up; explicit result scope retains output allocations until disposal.
Mutable binary partial payload is detached; source mutation does not affect results, payload charge remains until scope disposal, and oversized input rejects with zero residual reservations.
800-row real Parquet task fixture rejects 1 MiB with newly charged payload storage and succeeds at 4 MiB; all limits clean up reservations.

limits: Task partition storage and scan-to-partial payload lifetime are not yet admitted to MemoryBudget; evaluator detachment admits its own copies only.
Delegated task row payload ownership, partition key scratch admission and asynchronous partial-boundary ownership remain open.
No new cloud transport or whole-Worker memory guarantee is claimed.
